reports.reportsError: Could not load the report list.
reports.weatherInfoText: Shows current conditions, the daily forecast or the time zone for the selected property.
reports.weatherSourceNote: Data is retrieved from WeatherAPI when the report is generated. Forecasts can change.
reports.selectPropertiesHint: Use Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to select multiple properties.
reports.selectAtLeastOneProperty: Select at least one property or choose all properties.
reports.invalidDates: The start date must be on or before the end date.
reports.timeNote: Time filtering includes activities with a recorded time. Older records without a time are excluded.
reports.fieldHistoryTimeNote: The time filter only affects operations with a recorded time. Seasons, actions and untimed records remain included.
reports.invalidTimes: The start time must be on or before the end time.
reports.infoText: The period filters activities. The selected properties’ profile data is also included for context.
reports.activitySummaryInfoText: Compares activity counts, active days and latest activity by property and type. Irrigation rows also show recorded application depth.
reports.irrigationSummaryInfoText: Groups irrigation records by property and month, showing the total and average recorded depth in millimeters.
reports.fieldHistoryInfoText: Combines crop season starts and closures, field notebook operations and team actions within the period. The time filter applies only to records with a time; other records remain in the report.
reports.securityNote: The file includes only properties and activities in your account.
reports.snirhInfoText: Shows the latest available levels by hydrological station. Use the state and attention filters to narrow the list.
reports.rainfallInfoText: Shows 24-hour rainfall by station, its classification, last reading time and data age. Values reflect the current SNIRH query.
reports.snirhSecurityNote: The levels are public data retrieved from SNIRH.
